verdict.rationale: Reflect documents one-click, in-app publishing of individual notes to a public URL with clean, minimal styling, so publishing selected notes without leaving the app is covered. Nothing shows those published notes form a browsable site. The 'long hard-to-guess url' model points to isolated per-note sharing rather than a navigable garden. missing for 10: a browsable multi-note website or digital garden, evidence that [[links]] between published notes resolve as working links, site navigation or index, independent corroboration.
